operation.description:
Creates a deployment branch or tag policy for an environment.

OAuth app tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.

example-single-branch.summary: Example of a single branch name pattern

example-single-tag.summary: Example of a single tag name pattern

example-wildcard.summary: Example of a wildcard name pattern

303.description: Response if the same branch name pattern already exists

404.description: Not Found or `deployment_branch_policy.custom_branch_policies` property for the environment is set to false

#/components/parameters/environment-name.description: The name of the environment. The name must be URL encoded. For example, any slashes in the name must be replaced with `%2F`.
#/components/parameters/environment-name.name: environment_name

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/schemas/deployment-branch-p.description: Details of a deployment branch or tag policy.

id.description: The unique identifier of the branch or tag policy.

name.description: The name pattern that branches or tags must match in order to deploy to the environment.

type.description: Whether this rule targets a branch or tag.

#/components/schemas/deployment-branch-p.title: Deployment branch policy

name.description:
The name pattern that branches or tags must match in order to deploy to the environment.

Wildcard characters will not match `/`. For example, to match branches that begin with `release/` and contain an additional single slash, use `release/*/*`.
For more information about pattern matching syntax, see the [Ruby File.fnmatch documentation](https://ruby-doc.org/core-2.5.1/File.html#method-c-fnmatch).

type.description: Whether this rule targets a branch or tag

#/components/schemas/deployment-branch-p.title: Deployment branch and tag policy name pattern
